question.text: Zener diodes have higher dopant densities as compared to ordinary <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">p</mi><mo>-</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">n</mi></math> junction diodes. This

options.text: decreases the width of depletion layer as well as electric field
increases the width of depletion layer as well as electric field
decreases the width of depletion layer but increases the electric field
increases the width of depletion layer but decreases the electric field

solution.text: Due to high doping, electric field in the depletion layer increases.
